# Cupping

Recesses that seal against the resin tank and pull like a suction cup at each peel.

<figure markdown="span">
![Cupping: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/max-cup-area-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Cupping: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/max-cup-area-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>Opening of a recess sealed by the resin tank at each layer, which pulls a vacuum.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [Resin 3D Printing (SLA)](../../reference/processes/resin-3d-printing.md) | High |

## Values

**Aim for** is what to design for; crossing it gives a warning. **At most** is the hard limit; crossing it gives an error. See [aim for and limits](../../concepts/aim-for-and-limits.md).

Criticality in this process: **High** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

| Material | Aim for | At most | Source |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| **Default** | 100 mm² | 900 mm² | Engineering judgement, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "Formlabs says small cups usually print and large ones blow out, without a figure. 100 mm² is about an 11 mm hole; 900 mm² a 30 mm square") |

Every other material uses the Default values: Standard Resin, Tough / Durable Resin, Flexible / Elastic Resin.

## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

!!! warning "Warning"

    Suction cup (`{measured}`): `{feature}` (`{size}`) is sealed by `{sealed_by}`, so every peel pulls a vacuum in it. Expect a poor surface inside it. Vent it with a small hole through its floor, or tilt the part so it doesn't face the tank.
!!! failure "Error"

    Large suction cup (`{measured}`): `{feature}` (`{size}`) is sealed by `{sealed_by}`. A cup this large will likely bow in or blow out, or pull the part off its supports. Vent it through its floor, or reorient the part.
| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{measured}` | The measured value, with its unit |
| `{target}` | The rule's "Aim for" value |
| `{limit}` | The rule's "At most" value |
| `{feature}` | What it is about, such as "Boss 3 (screw)" or "Face12" |
| `{size}` | Its size or what was found, such as "Ø3.00 mm and 9.00 mm deep" |
| `{sealed_by}` | What seals the cup: the tank's film, or the build platform |
